TALK_REPLY_PRAISE_NEG_0: “With respect, I know I haven't been good enough. Don't sugar-coat it.”
TALK_REPLY_PRAISE_NEG_1: “Praise? After the games I've had? I'd rather you were straight with me.”
TALK_REPLY_PRAISE_NEG_2: He looks puzzled. “Are we watching the same matches?”
TALK_REPLY_CRITICISE_POS_0: “You're right. I'll show you on the pitch.”
TALK_REPLY_CRITICISE_POS_1: “Fair enough. I needed to hear that.”
TALK_REPLY_CRITICISE_NEU_1: He listens without a word and leaves the office.
TALK_REPLY_CRITICISE_NEU_2: “Everyone has bad spells. I'll get through it.”
TALK_REPLY_CRITICISE_NEG_0: “That's not fair at all. I've given everything for this club.”
TALK_REPLY_CRITICISE_NEG_1: He storms out. “Find someone else to blame.”
TALK_REPLY_CRITICISE_NEG_2: “If that's what you think of me, maybe I'm in the wrong place.”
TALK_REPLY_PLAYING_TIME_POS_0: “Thanks for explaining. I know what I need to do to get in the side.”
TALK_REPLY_PLAYING_TIME_POS_1: “That's honest. I can live with that for now.”
TALK_REPLY_PLAYING_TIME_POS_2: “Good to know where I stand. I'll be ready when you need me.”
TALK_REPLY_PLAYING_TIME_NEU_0: “I hear you. I just want to play.”
TALK_REPLY_PLAYING_TIME_NEU_1: “Okay. Let's see how the next few weeks go.”
TALK_REPLY_PLAYING_TIME_NEU_2: He shrugs. “It is what it is.”
TALK_REPLY_PLAYING_TIME_NEG_0: “I'm not here to sit on the bench. I expected more.”
TALK_REPLY_PLAYING_TIME_NEG_1: “That's not what I was told when I signed.”
TALK_REPLY_PLAYING_TIME_NEG_2: “So I'm just a squad player to you? Great.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_PLAYING_TIME_POS_0: “That's all I wanted to hear. I won't let you down.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_PLAYING_TIME_POS_1: “Deal. I'll be ready from the first minute.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_PLAYING_TIME_NEU_0: “Words are one thing. I'll believe it when I see my name on the team sheet.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_PLAYING_TIME_NEG_0: “I've heard that before. Forgive me if I don't get excited.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_CONTRACT_POS_0: “Brilliant. I want my future to be here.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_CONTRACT_POS_1: “Thank you. My agent will be glad to hear it.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_CONTRACT_NEU_0: “Let's see what the offer looks like.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_CONTRACT_NEU_1: “Fine. But don't leave it too late.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_CONTRACT_NEG_0: “You've said things like that before. I'll wait for the paperwork.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_CONTRACT_NEG_1: “We'll see. I'm keeping my options open.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_SIGNING_POS_0: “That's the ambition I wanted to see. Let's go for it.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_SIGNING_POS_1: “Great. With a couple of quality players we can do something special.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_SIGNING_NEU_1: “Okay. I'll keep an eye on the news.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_SIGNING_NEG_0: “The board will never spend that kind of money. I'm not naive.”
TALK_REPLY_PROMISE_SIGNING_NEG_1: “I'll believe it when they're standing in the dressing room.”
TALK_REPLY_PATIENCE_POS_0: “Alright. I trust you. I'll keep working and wait for my chance.”
TALK_REPLY_PATIENCE_POS_1: “Okay, boss. I'll give it some time.”
TALK_REPLY_PATIENCE_NEU_0: “I can wait a little. Not forever.”
TALK_REPLY_PATIENCE_NEU_1: “Fine. But something has to change soon.”
TALK_REPLY_PATIENCE_NEG_1: “Patience? My career isn't going to wait for me.”
TALK_REPLY_REASSURE_POS_0: “Good. This is where I want to be.”
TALK_REPLY_REASSURE_POS_1: “Thanks for backing me. That settles it for me.”
TALK_REPLY_REASSURE_NEU_1: “I appreciate it. My head is all over the place right now.”
TALK_REPLY_REASSURE_NEG_0: “So you'll stand in the way of the move of my life?”
TALK_REPLY_REASSURE_NEG_1: “That's easy for you to say. It's my career.”
TALK_REPLY_OPEN_TO_OFFERS_POS_0: “Thanks for being honest with me. I respect that.”
TALK_REPLY_OPEN_TO_OFFERS_POS_1: “Good. If the right club comes in, I'd like to hear about it.”
TALK_REPLY_OPEN_TO_OFFERS_NEU_1: “Fair enough. I'll just focus on playing.”
TALK_REPLY_OPEN_TO_OFFERS_NEG_0: “So you want rid of me? After everything?”
TALK_REPLY_OPEN_TO_OFFERS_NEG_1: “I thought I mattered here. Apparently not.”
TALK_REPLY_ACCEPT_TRANSFER_POS_0: “Thank you. I'll give everything until the day I leave.”
TALK_REPLY_ACCEPT_TRANSFER_POS_1: “I appreciate you not standing in my way.”
TALK_REPLY_REFUSE_TRANSFER_POS_0: “Okay. I don't agree, but I'll keep giving my best.”
TALK_REPLY_REFUSE_TRANSFER_POS_1: “Fine. I'm a professional. You'll get nothing less from me.”
TALK_REPLY_REFUSE_TRANSFER_NEU_1: “That's your decision. Don't expect me to be happy about it.”
TALK_REPLY_REFUSE_TRANSFER_NEG_0: “Then you'll have an unhappy player on your hands.”
TALK_REPLY_REFUSE_TRANSFER_NEG_1: He slams the door on his way out.
